contract_manufacturing.summary: Core business. Strategic focus: H1 (casting/forging + machined parts) and H8 (managed sourcing & QA), with H3 (CNC machining) as running revenue model. Revenue targets: $5M → $20M → $50M → $100M. Preparing seed round investor presentation (Oct 2026). Lead times: CNC 20-30 days, casting 45-60 days, sea transit 25-35 days.
contract_manufacturing.details: Multi-client parametric Excel costing calculator with VLOOKUP-based Materials and MachineRates. Key calibration: serial turning real cycle = model ×0.4-0.55. Xometry Europe unfulfilled grades (vendor development opportunity): Ti Gr2/Gr5, SS303, 17-4PH, 42CrMo4, 16MnCr5, PEEK, PE500, 1.2316. MM pays DDP freight + duty at shipment, recovers in final invoice. WC model: supplier 50% at PO / 50% at dispatch; ~half of customers pay only 10% advance (MM funds 40% gap); ~half pay balance only after arrival (~45 days). German investor backing. Planning follow-on raise over 18 months (IT, marketing, working capital).
